description: Ministry of Sports - Regulation made by the Ministry of Sports under Section 41 read with Section 31 of the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulation made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It specifically amends previous regulations published in earlier gazettes. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, legal amendments, and statutory instruments, which are characteristic of Type 5 classification.
